last_seq.description: Highest seq the runner has emitted for this run.

input.description: Tool input as reported by the CLI.

output.description: Truncated to 16 KiB by the runner.

modes.description: Modes this adapter supports, in preference order.

patch.description: Unified patch (`git diff base...head`), capped at 2 MiB.

base.description: Defaults to the branch's recorded base.

content.description: Base64 content; `None` when missing, binary or too large.

active_runs.description: Runs still alive (or with unacked spool) on this runner.

name.description: Display name chosen by the user (`--name`), defaults to the hostname.

runner_token.description: `coffe_rt_…`; sent exactly once, only its SHA-256 hash is stored server-side.

oneOf.description: Shell in a ticket worktree.
Shell in the registered repo root.

available.description: False when the registered path no longer exists or is not a git repo.

path.description: Absolute path on the runner machine (display only; never used as input by the server).

remote_url.description: Remote URL with any credentials stripped.

seq.description: Cumulative: every message with `seq <= ack` is persisted.

RunDriver.description: Which structured protocol to use with the CLI (only meaningful for `RunMode::Structured`).

oneOf.description: The CLI's own headless JSON stream (default).
Agent Client Protocol over stdio (live permission prompts, steering, cancel).

data.description: Base64 terminal bytes (raw PTY output or rendered transcript).

auto_commit.description: Commit all changes after the run (ticket runs).

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the final answer must satisfy (planning runs).

prompt.description: The task prompt (context is delivered separately in `context`).

test_command.description: Shell command run in the worktree after a successful run (review gate test results).

resumable.description: Set with `interrupted`: whether the CLI session can be resumed.

usage.description: Cumulative usage for the run so far.

oneOf.description: First and only message on a pairing connection (`Bearer coffe_pt_…`).
Generic success reply to a control-plane request (`re` set).
Generic failure reply (`re` set) or unsolicited error.

id.description: Unique message id (UUID v4 or v7).

re.description: Id of the control-plane request this message answers.

box_key_signature.description: Ed25519 signature (base64) over the raw 32 bytes of `box_public_key`.

box_public_key.description: X25519 public key (base64), recipient of sealed secrets.

ServerEnvelope.description: Frame sent by the control plane.

oneOf.description: Reply to `pair`; the server closes the pairing connection afterwards.

output_tail.description: Last ~8 KiB of the test command output.

available.description: False when the CLI exposes no usage data at all (counts are then zero and meaningless).

cost_usd.description: Only when the CLI itself reports cost; estimates are computed by the control plane.

credits.description: Vendor credits consumed (CLIs that meter in credits instead of tokens, e.g. Kiro).

duration_ms.description: CLI-reported duration (API or wall time), when available.

cancel.description: Runs the control plane considers finished/cancelled; the runner must stop them.

resume.description: Highest persisted seq per run; the runner replays everything above it.
